us-ava-register.locator: Rows for Red Mountain, Walla Walla Valley, Finger Lakes, Monticello, Old Mission Peninsula; linked 27 CFR 9.167, 9.91, 9.34, 9.48, 9.114
us-ava-register.reviewNote: Names and state/county context checked against the register and current eCFR boundary descriptions. Locator dots are approximate reference points, not legal polygons.

wa-red-mountain.name: Red Mountain AVA
wa-red-mountain.locator: Location; Top varieties; climate/soils; regional map
wa-red-mountain.reviewNote: Warm dry setting and Cabernet relevance; do not treat every vineyard, wine or changing planting percentage as identical.

wa-walla-walla.name: Walla Walla Valley AVA
wa-walla-walla.locator: Location; Top varieties; shared Washington/Oregon appellation; soils and map
wa-walla-walla.reviewNote: Cross-state AVA with varied sites. The whole valley is not the Oregon-only Rocks District.

ny-finger-lakes.name: Finger Lakes winegrowing region
ny-finger-lakes.locator: Finger Lakes; soils; Climate; regional map
ny-finger-lakes.reviewNote: Supports Riesling relevance and lake moderation. No universal soil, sweetness or exact growing-season duration is inferred.

va-monticello.name: Central Virginia: Monticello AVA
va-monticello.reviewNote: Central Piedmont/eastern Blue Ridge setting. The broader tourism region is not used as the AVA boundary or proof of fruit origin.

mi-old-mission.name: Old Mission Peninsula setting
mi-old-mission.locator: Peninsula extent; Wine Making / cool-climate context
mi-old-mission.reviewNote: Regional setting only; Michigan ice-wine statements are not applied to Canadian icewine rules or used to define this dry Riesling.

hedges-rm-cab-2023.name: HFE Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2023: Red Mountain
hedges-rm-cab-2023.locator: Page 1: Red Mountain AVA; Blend; Vineyards; Production; release
hedges-rm-cab-2023.reviewNote: 85% Cabernet Sauvignon-led blend from named estate AVA vineyards, with barrel maturation. Its sweeping 20+ year regional cellaring statement is not generalized.

lecole-ww-syrah-2023.name: Estate Seven Hills Vineyard Syrah 2023
lecole-ww-syrah-2023.locator: Page 1: Walla Walla Valley; Seven Hills Vineyard; Winemaking; Composition
lecole-ww-syrah-2023.reviewNote: 100% Syrah from Seven Hills, with stems and barrel ageing. Winery address in Washington does not define vineyard state or the full AVA; no Rocks District character is assigned to the whole valley.

frank-dry-riesling-2024.name: Dr. Konstantin Frank Dry Riesling 2024
frank-dry-riesling-2024.locator: Page 1: Variety; Vinification; Vessel; Fermentation; Vineyard; The Wine
frank-dry-riesling-2024.reviewNote: Named dry 100% Riesling from Keuka/Seneca estate sites, steel/unoaked. No literal shale flavour transfer or claim that all Finger Lakes Riesling is dry.

king-cabfranc-2024.name: King Family Cabernet Franc 2024
king-cabfranc-2024.locator: Page 1: AVA; Vineyard; Variety; RS; Winemaking
king-cabfranc-2024.reviewNote: Monticello origin explicitly stated; 95% Cabernet Franc plus Malbec/Merlot. Three-to-five-year advice lacks a clear time origin and is not copied as a regional window.

king-viognier-2023.name: King Family Viognier 2023
king-viognier-2023.locator: Page 1: title; AVA; Vineyard; Variety; Winemaking
king-viognier-2023.reviewNote: Trade page labels its link 2024, but the actual PDF is 2023. It is 84% Viognier/16% Chardonnay with mixed vessels, not a pure-Viognier or all-new-oak recipe. No sugar analysis is given.

cgt-dry-riesling.name: Chateau Grand Traverse Dry Riesling
cgt-dry-riesling.locator: Dry Riesling description; Wine Specs; lees contact; food pairing suggestions
cgt-dry-riesling.reviewNote: Explicit dry Old Mission Peninsula example. Page lists a 2024 vintage with 2023 harvest date and a sugar figure without units; those exact dates/units are not inferred or displayed as measurements.

ucd-vidal-blanc.name: UC Davis Foundation Plant Services — Vidal blanc
ucd-vidal-blanc.publisher: University of California, Davis — Foundation Plant Services
ucd-vidal-blanc.locator: Grape Variety: Vidal blanc; Countries of Origin; Species; Pedigree; Berry Color
ucd-vidal-blanc.reviewNote: White interspecific hybrid of French origin, Ugni blanc x Seibel 4986 (Rayon d’Or), synonym Vidal 256. No claim of Canadian indigenous vinifera identity. Scores are editorial, not genetic properties.

canada-icewine-identity.name: Canadian Standards of Identity, Volume 8 — Icewine
canada-icewine-identity.reviewNote: Natural freezing on the vine and provincial determination for Canadian production. Current incorporated standard, not the repealed SOR/2014-10. Does not establish Ontario’s numerical thresholds for other provinces.

ontario-icewine-categories.name: Ontario wine categories and labelling
ontario-icewine-categories.locator: Wine categories: Late Harvest / Icewine; Vintage
ontario-icewine-categories.reviewNote: Ontario natural-freeze definition, below −8°C harvest and at least 35° Brix juice; late harvest categories distinguished. Brix is juice sugar, not finished residual sugar or an atlas score.

ontario-icewine-process.name: Ontario Icewine — production and serving context
ontario-icewine-process.publisher: Wine Country Ontario / Wine Marketing Association of Ontario
ontario-icewine-process.locator: What is Icewine; VQA requirements; grape varieties and food pairing sections
ontario-icewine-process.reviewNote: Ontario harvest and pressing while naturally frozen at or below −8°C, concentration and varietal context. Broad promotional claims about guaranteed annual crops or world superiority are not adopted; Ontario thresholds are not generalized to BC.

niagara-appellation.name: Niagara Peninsula appellation
niagara-appellation.locator: Appellation overview; Characteristics: Topography, Soil and Climate
niagara-appellation.reviewNote: Niagara Peninsula geography, Lake Ontario / Escarpment moderation, variable glacial soils and grape relevance. Approximate locator is not a boundary map; no universal soil or guaranteed winter harvest.

inniskillin-vidal-2023.name: Inniskillin Pearl Vidal Icewine 2023
inniskillin-vidal-2023.publisher: Inniskillin producer material hosted by Maisons Marques & Domaines
inniskillin-vidal-2023.locator: Overview; Winemaking; Tasting Notes; Food Pairing; Technical Information
inniskillin-vidal-2023.reviewNote: 100% Vidal Blanc, Niagara Peninsula, naturally frozen harvest, slow cool fermentation; 224 g/L residual sugar and 9.5% ABV in this example. No oak regime or universal cellaring duration is inferred.

inniskillin-riesling-2022.name: Inniskillin Riesling Icewine 2022
inniskillin-riesling-2022.publisher: Inniskillin producer material hosted by Maisons Marques & Domaines
inniskillin-riesling-2022.locator: Overview; Winemaking; Tasting Notes; Food Pairing; Technical Information
inniskillin-riesling-2022.reviewNote: 100% Riesling, Niagara Peninsula, −10°C harvest, cool fermentation; 200 g/L residual sugar and 9.5% ABV. Producer tasting and technical sections support the reference, not third-party review windows.

inniskillin-cabfranc-2022.name: Inniskillin Cabernet Franc Icewine 2022
inniskillin-cabfranc-2022.publisher: Inniskillin producer material hosted by Maisons Marques & Domaines
inniskillin-cabfranc-2022.locator: Overview; Winemaking; Tasting Notes; Food Pairing; Technical Information
inniskillin-cabfranc-2022.reviewNote: 100% Cabernet Franc from Niagara Peninsula vineyards; pressing supplies red colour with no skin contact during fermentation; cool fermentation and steel holding; 263.8 g/L residual sugar and 9.5% ABV. Third-party review text appears duplicated from Riesling and is not used.

r10-bordeaux-appellation.name: Bordeaux AOC: varieties and diversity
r10-bordeaux-appellation.publisher: Conseil Interprofessionnel du Vin de Bordeaux
r10-bordeaux-appellation.locator: Bordeaux AOC reds and whites; available varieties and diverse blends

r10-prosecco-types.name: Prosecco DOC types and sweetness
r10-prosecco-types.locator: Spumante sweetness designations including Brut and Extra Dry

r10-prosecco-label.name: Recognizing Prosecco DOC
r10-prosecco-label.locator: Prosecco DOC label and certification cues

r10-sherry-styles.name: Sherry wine classification
r10-sherry-styles.locator: Dry generoso, naturally sweet and blended styles

r10-phylloxera.name: Grapevine phylloxera
r10-phylloxera.locator: Root damage, susceptible vinifera and resistant/tolerant rootstock response

r10-noval-nacional.name: Quinta do Noval Nacional Vintage Port 2024
r10-noval-nacional.locator: Small ungrafted Nacional parcel and named bottling; not a claim about all Douro vines

r10-bollinger-vvf.name: Bollinger Vieilles Vignes Françaises
r10-bollinger-vvf.locator: Two ungrafted Aÿ parcels and named cuvée; not a claim about all Champagne vines
